- cipheraenys \<https://github.com/cipheraenys\> - initial implementation of same-Commit member replacement in MLS, letting an Add proposal keep the signature key and credential of a member a Remove in the same proposal list takes out of the tree, with the regression test behind it (PR #2505).

- Paul Gregoire \<https://github.com/mondain\> - initial implementation of DTLS 1.3 (RFC 9147) in the low-level TLS API: the record layer with record number encryption, the ACK-driven reliable handshake with datagram packing, the client and server handshakes with HelloRetryRequest and client authentication, and the post-handshake KeyUpdate and acknowledgement machinery (PRs #2439, #2440, #2441, #2442).

- bright-k \<https://github.com/bright-k\> - reuse of a single counter block buffer in GCMBlockCipher in place of a per-block allocation, with the streaming, overlap, partial-block and buffer-cleanup regression tests for it (PR #2540).
+- hidingmyname \<https://github.com/hidingmyname\> - corrections to the CMS parser, CRL generator, ISO 7816-4 padding and DH agreement documentation and exception messages (PR #2537).
* A padder that adds the padding according to the scheme referenced in
- * ISO 7814-4 - scheme 2 from ISO 9797-1. The first byte is 0x80, rest is 0x00
+ * ISO 7816-4 - scheme 2 from ISO 9797-1. The first byte is 0x80, rest is 0x00

- CMSAuthenticatedDataParser.getUnauthAttrs() always returned null, as its constructor never marked the unauthenticated attributes as unread, and the AuthenticatedDataParser beneath it cast the streamed element to ASN1TaggedObject rather than ASN1TaggedObjectParser, so once reached it threw ClassCastException. The streaming parser now returns the unauthenticated attributes as the non-streaming CMSAuthenticatedData does (github #2532).

- CryptoServicesRegistrar.setGlobalProperty(), and the class's static initializer through the same path, also stored the value as a thread property of the calling thread, so the thread that first used CryptoServicesRegistrar kept the default DSA and DH parameters - and with them the class loader that loaded Bouncy Castle - for as long as it lived, preventing a discarded web application or plugin class loader from being collected. A global value is now copied only onto a thread that already has a value of its own for the property, and clearing the last thread property removes the thread's property map. A thread that set a global value now also sees a later global value set by another thread, rather than keeping its own copy. Relates to github #2536.

- SExpression.hasLabel() cast a first value that was not a string to an octet string, so an expression starting with a nested expression - as the protected part of a GnuPG private-keys-v1.d key does - threw a ClassCastException, and getExpressionWithLabel() and getExpressionWithLabelOrFail() threw it for any such child. hasLabel() now returns false for an expression that starts with anything other than a string or octet string, and for an empty expression, where it threw IllegalArgumentException. Relates to github #2535.

+- The javadoc of CMSAuthenticatedDataParser.getMacAlgParams() described the encryption algorithm parameters, getAuthAttrs() in CMSAuthenticatedDataParser and CMSAuthEnvelopedDataParser described the unauthenticated attributes, X509V2CRLGenerator.setIssuerDN() described the issuer as signing a certificate rather than the CRL, and ISO7816d4Padding cited ISO 7814-4 for ISO 7816-4. The getMacAlgParams() failure in CMSAuthenticatedData and CMSAuthenticatedDataParser now reports "exception getting MAC parameters" rather than "exception getting encryption parameters". Relates to github #2526, #2527, #2528 and #2529.

+- DHAgreement and DHBasicAgreement reported a key that is not a DHPrivateKeyParameters as "DHEngine expects DHPrivateKeyParameters", naming a class that does not exist; each now names itself. Relates to github #2530.
